policy.principle: Company HQ owns UI, task authority, routing policy, project boundaries, and human approvals. Upstreams are capabilities, not competing control planes.
policy.provider_auth: native-first; explicit API gateway only when user chooses it
policy.model_selection: smallest capable authorized model first; escalate on risk/failure
policy.claims: measured evidence over upstream marketing claims

desktop_control.notes: Reuse provider/runtime/team/worktree/diff patterns selectively; do not stack another task authority.

orchestration.notes: Adopt Ruflo cost/workflow/intelligence/observability/security capabilities behind Company HQ. Do not enable a second autonomous scheduler by default.

provider_runtime.notes: Never silently convert a native subscription route into API billing or third-party relay.

code_intelligence.notes: Winner selected by deterministic benchmark plus product-tree isolation. Serena is evaluated as an editing/refactoring capability.

memory.notes: Use scoped retrieval and progressive disclosure; do not inject whole histories.

token_efficiency.notes: RTK is first choice for deterministic command-output compaction. Headroom must pass matched accuracy/auth-route benchmarks before inline use; proxy wrapping is not default.

tasks_and_coordination.notes: Borrow dependency/claim/message semantics as useful. Vibe Kanban is sunsetting.

skills.notes: Select one or a few relevant skills per task; never inject whole catalogs.

native_runtime_future.python: optional integration and scientific tooling, not required final launcher
